name: rosetta-factors-of-a-mersenne-number
code:
use default

mod_pow(base: bigint, exponent: bigint, modulus: bigint) -> bigint is
    let result mut = 1n
    let b mut = base % modulus
    let e mut = exponent

    while e > 0n do
        if e % 2n =~ 1n then
            result = (result * b) % modulus
        fi

        e = e / 2n
        b = (b * b) % modulus
    od

    result
si

find_mersenne_factor(p: int, limit: int) -> bigint? =>
    (1::limit)
        |> map(k => bigint(2 * k * p + 1))
        |> filter(candidate => mod_pow(2n, bigint(p), candidate) =~ 1n)
        |> first()

show(p: int, limit: int) is
    if let factor = find_mersenne_factor(p, limit) then
        write_line("2^{p} - 1 is divisible by {factor}")
    else
        write_line("no factor of 2^{p} - 1 found below k = {limit}")
    fi
si

show(11, 100)
show(23, 100)
show(31, 100)
